en.title: Racing Results
en.description:
Accumulate scores from the (race, racer_id, position) records of the races. Positions 1..6 earn 10, 6, 4, 3, 2, 1 points respectively, and any other position earns 0 points. The racer with the highest total wins; on a tie, the smallest racer_id wins.

The input/output protocol and the limits marked as 'added by this site' were compiled by this site; limits not given in the original problem are not treated as part of the original source.
en.input: The first line contains R M, where R is the number of racers and M is the number of result records; each of the next M lines is race racer_id position. Added by this site: 1≤R≤100, 0≤M≤10000, race∈[2001,2100], racer IDs are consecutive, 1001..1000+R; each (race,racer_id) has at most one record, and position∈[1,R]. Racers who do not appear in any record are ranked with 0 points.
en.output: Output the winner's ID and total score, separated by a space.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the algorithm idea, proof of correctness, and complexity.
